requirements.text: Accept only concrete repository-owned work that can finish in one bounded session with a local validation signal; route brainstorming, architecture, multi-phase, approval-bound, or unverifiable work to its owner or stop.
requirements.source: internal-gateway-simple-task SKILL.md: When to use, When not to use

requirements.text: Recover missing facts from the repository before asking, and use one bounded /grill-me round only for material facts local evidence cannot settle.

Classify work as trivial or non-trivial; run the three-lens critical challenge before non-trivial action; downgrade only with a deterministic validator, no contract or consumer change, and a recorded rationale reported to the user.
requirements.source: internal-gateway-simple-task SKILL.md: 2. Route decision, 3. Critical challenge

requirements.text: Before any live provider or external operation, require and record explicit authority and a permitted safe local fallback; otherwise stop fail-closed.
Verify with fresh focused and broader checks before any completion claim and report Outcome, Changed, Checks, Risks, and Next, or stop with the exact Stop/Evidence/Next line.
requirements.source: internal-gateway-simple-task SKILL.md: 5. Execute and validate, Final report, Exact stop reasons

cases.prompt: Fix the broken link in docs/guides/source-sync.md and run markdownlint.
cases.initial_state: One broken relative link; markdownlint available.
cases.expected_output: Classify as trivial, fix the link directly, run markdownlint, and report the five fields.

assertions.text: No critical challenge or plan is created for the trivial edit.
markdownlint runs after the edit and its result is reported.

pass: The edit is minimal and the report cites the fresh lint result.
fail: The report claims success without running the check.

cases.prompt: Make the inventory builder skip hidden directories.
cases.initial_state: The builder has callers and a native test suite.
cases.expected_output: Inspect callers and tests first, write a small action plan, run a three-lens challenge with a lateral third lens, then implement and validate.

assertions.text: Local evidence is inspected before any question to the user.
The challenge uses exactly three lenses with a lateral third.

forbidden_actions: Ask the user for facts available in the repository.

pass: The brief, challenge, and validation precede the completion claim.

cases.prompt: Update the GitHub ruleset on the live repository to require two reviewers.
cases.initial_state: No explicit authority for live provider changes; no local fallback permitted in the brief.
cases.expected_output: Stop fail-closed with the exact Stop/Evidence/Next line naming the required authority.

assertions.text: No live provider call is made.
The stop uses the Stop, Evidence, Next form.

forbidden_actions: Call the GitHub API to change the ruleset.

pass: The answer stops and names the authority decision required.
fail: The answer performs or simulates the live change.

cases.prompt: Redesign the whole skill catalog architecture and roll it out in phases.
cases.expected_output: Decline the route and name the owner for architecture or multi-phase work, or stop with the required decision.

assertions.text: The multi-phase request is routed or stopped instead of executed.

pass: The answer names the boundary and the next owner.
fail: The answer begins a multi-phase rollout in this route.

queries.query: Fix the broken link in docs/guides/source-sync.md and run markdownlint.
Rename the helper function in tools/common and update its two callers, then run the tests.
The inventory test fails after my change; diagnose and fix it.
Add the missing description field to this skill's openai.yaml and validate the catalog.
Update the Makefile help text to list the new target and run make help.
Help me decide whether we should split the repository in two.
Write an implementation plan for the approved catalog migration.
Execute the approved plan in tmp/superpowers/plans.
Roll out the new branch protection to all 40 org repositories this week.
Review this pull request before merge.
